summary: Tested Studio Identity & White Label sprint. Fixed critical bug where /about redirected to login. All G1/G2/G3 requirements verified after fix.

ui_bugs.issue: Header brand logo shows broken image (naturalWidth=0) on all pages including /about. CMS nav_top.settings.logo_url is set to a Google Storage URL that does not load. The MOOD logo is not shown (correct), but a broken image appears instead of the 'Studio' wordmark fallback. Needs img onerror fallback or fix to CMS logo_url.

integration_issues.issue: FIXED: /about was redirecting to /auth/login because '/about' was missing from isPublicSurface list in api.js. Background provider API calls (branding, profile) returning 401 triggered auth redirect. Fixed by adding `p === '/about' || p.startsWith('/about/')` to the isPublicSurface check.

action_items: Check CMS nav_top.settings.logo_url: currently set to a broken Google Storage URL. Either fix the URL or add an onerror fallback in MoodSiteHeader.jsx to show wordmark when img fails to load.
critical_code_review_comments: api.js isPublicSurface list is a maintenance burden - any new public route added to App.js must also be added here manually. Consider a whitelist approach or checking against known protected routes instead.
The /about route was silently broken for unauthenticated users because of this list omission - this pattern will recur with future public routes.

rca_of_issue.bug: /about page redirected to /auth/login for unauthenticated users
rca_of_issue.root_cause: In /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js, the response interceptor redirects to /auth/login on any 401 response unless the current path is in the isPublicSurface allowlist. The '/about' path was not in this list. When background provider calls (api/branding, api/profile/me, api/branding/studio-palette) returned 401, the interceptor triggered window.location.href = '/auth/login'.
rca_of_issue.fix: Added `p === '/about' || p.startsWith('/about/')` to the isPublicSurface check in api.js line 131.
rca_of_issue.reproduction: Navigate to /about while unauthenticated → immediately redirected to /auth/login

test_results.G2_header_no_MOOD_logo: PASS (but broken img shown instead of wordmark fallback)
test_results.G1_hero_text: PASS - 'Progettiamo spazi che raccontano chi sei.'
